leaves.name: hB6
leaves.doc: Conductor-level X0 parametrization, a consequence of BCDT Theorem A
leaves.source: BCDT cited author manuscript, Theorem A p. 1 and Introduction (6) p. 3 (JAMS 14 (2001), 843–939); diophantine_zq.tex lem:forward-rank L1092 and sec:rc L1779–1784; Milne MF v1.31, Thm. 11.19 and Rmk. 11.18 (p. 117)
leaves.flag: AI read (fork issue #83 and A066/A070 audits): BCDT (6), p. 3, is X1(N(E)) → E. X0(N_E) needs trivial nebentypus, Shimura's J0 quotient and Faltings; tex L1779–1784 cites Milne MF Thm. 11.19 and Rmk. 11.18 for this step.
